name: block-showcase-frame
use: A menu of pages on the left and a live frame on the right that opens the chosen one: a showcase of several working pages.
avoid: Pages that refuse to be framed; a page read mostly on phones (the frame takes most of the screen).
props: { kind: 'block-showcase-frame'; id: string; badge?: string; title: string; note?: string; menuTitle: string; frameTitle: string; items: { id: string; label: string; href: string }[] }

cases.title: Showcase of the sections of a block catalogue
cases.why: Several working pages viewed in one place without leaving the page.

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-showcase-frame. In a page: { "kind": "block-showcase-frame", "id": "…", "title": "…", "menuTitle": "…", "frameTitle": "…", "items": [ { "id", "label", "href" } ] }.
